title: Chapter 471
text:
Ka ka ka!

The sound of the mechanical components expanding instantly drowned out the sound of Ashes' carbon particles rubbing against each other.

Along the walls and corners, hundreds of cannons suddenly expanded their bases, and the triple-headed large-caliber cannons exuded a ferocious aura. Most of the gunpowder cannons had been replaced with electromagnetic cannons, and ten laser cannons had been added to increase their penetrative power. [High Energy Control] allowed Han Xiao to obtain energy weapon technology.

Dong dong dong!

The cannons let out a furious roar, and the large-caliber cannons' sound was loud and full. The metal of the cannons vibrated and buzzed.

Thirty to forty black panther-type mechanical beasts pounced out, and the rapid-fire cannons on their shoulders kept firing. On the ceiling, mechanical spiders with a cold gleam crawled along the walls. Other than the black panther mechanical beasts, Han Xiao also created small mechanical beasts, which were the mechanical insect series. Other than spiders, there were also centipedes, scorpions, mechanical bees, and so on.

He only needed one mechanical spider blueprint, and he could draw inferences from it and create different insect-type mechanical blueprints.

Philip commanded all of these mechanical beasts to attack Ashes.

The black cloud of carbon particles in the air suddenly shrank, turning into a sphere and enveloping Ashes tightly. The outer layer turned into diamond, and the dense rain of bullets hit it. The diamond layer exploded layer by layer, but the shattered parts turned back into particles and filled the gap again. The shield was almost endless.

Seeing this, Han Xiao's face twitched. "This is the Sand Shield? Shameless! "

At this moment, Ashes' indifferent voice came from the diamond ball. "Even if you set up a trap in advance, even if you're immune to my carbon element deconstruction, in front of my current ability, the only outcome for you is … a complete defeat!"

Boom!

The next moment, the front of the diamond ball suddenly turned into a turbulent black wave, crashing down like an avalanche. More than ten mechanical beasts were swept in and turned into piles of scrap metal in the blink of an eye. Not only were there signs of being crushed, but there were also signs of being crazily cut up.

'This power is a little strange. It can instantly destroy the mechanical beast's armor?'

Han Xiao did not have the time to observe. He clapped his palms together, and a compressed orb from each of his bracelets unfolded, turning into thirty-two platinum-colored floating shuttles. They arranged themselves in a circle and suspended behind Han Xiao. A laser beam shot out from the tip of each of the shuttles. Every four beams were focused on one point, forming eight light spots in front of Han Xiao.

Following that, there was some kind of reaction between the light spots. A line connected the eight light spots, forming a halo. The middle part of the halo seemed to have been painted with a brush, and a mirror-like golden light energy shield appeared!

The black tide surged and slammed into the golden shield. Like a wave crashing into a reef, it turned into a black stream of water that split into two sides. Under the control of Ashes, the black tide that slid away came back from behind Han Xiao.

At the same time, the arrangement of the Floating Shield Shuttles changed. The eight light spots were arranged in a three-dimensional manner, forming a shield in front of and behind Han Xiao, forming a trapezoid. The black tide attacked back and forth like a tide. The trapezoid energy shield flickered with electricity, but it did not move at all.

"Floating Shield Shuttles, Halo Array!"

[High Energy Control] was the core knowledge of the Mechanic class. Han Xiao had created quite a number of good things during this period. This [Halo Array] was like a strengthened version of the Sonic Sphere, combining both offense and defense.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and observed the black tide. He immediately discovered the reason for its strange power.

The black tide was only the form on the surface. In the fine areas, some of the carbon elements turned into diamond shards, spinning at high speed in different directions. It was like the mouth of a worm that was filled with sharp teeth. It was also like a wheel saw, having extremely strong cutting power.

In this large black tide, there were at least a few hundred 'diamond wheel saws'. It was like an undercurrent, and it was difficult to notice if one did not look carefully. It was no wonder that the mechanical beasts were destroyed in an instant.

This meant that if the black cloud of carbon particles covered a building, it would be able to cut it into pieces in a few seconds. Its destructive power was far beyond the form on the surface. It was like a group of metal-eating ants that could turn an elephant into a skeleton in an instant.

Although he was very tanky, he did not want to use his delicate body to experience such power.

As expected of a Calamity Grade Super. He could not do such fine and conflicting operations in the past. His control of his Esper Ability has improved. I have to be more careful, Han Xiao thought.

As he said that, the Void Dragon mechanical suit appeared on his body, and he charged toward Ashes. It was difficult to break through Ashes' defense in a mid-range battle. He would only have a chance if he got close.

Aroshia turned into a stream of light and entered Ashes' diamond ball. These particles could only make her energy body ripple but could not form an effective attack. After energizing, her immunity to physical damage was extremely high.

Hum!

The light of an energy explosion shone through the diamond ball.

Ashes was blasted by Aroshia, and he could not help but retreat. He dispelled the diamond ball and turned it into a flat shield. He had to ensure that his vision was clear. This energy lifeform was immune to most physical damage, and it made him feel uncomfortable.

Countless bullets created sparks on the diamond shield. Ashes glanced at it, and with a wave of his hand, the black cloud suddenly dispersed and no longer condensed. It turned into black sand, and the carbon particles entered the gaps of the machinery, destroying the internal circuits of the machinery.

Bzzt!

Sparks exploded at the same time, and a large number of machines were paralyzed.

"The battle is over." Ashes sneered.

As long as these machines were destroyed, the Mechanic would be like a tiger without its teeth.

Black Star countered his Esper Ability, and he countered Black Star in the same way.

However, looking up, Ashes realized that Han Xiao did not stop at all. It was as if he was indifferent to this.

Han Xiao rushed in front of Ashes, and a complicated melee machine appeared in his hand. It was very heavy and almost two meters long. It looked like a giant sword with a guard, but it had a very high-tech feel. Its shape was not the ancient cold weapon type but more like a gun with a barrel. This was a weapon of the same type, called [High Frequency Strike Cannon]. It was a multi-purpose melee machine weapon.

The new weapon replaced the electromagnetic scythe that could no longer keep up with its strength.

The blade was embedded in the mechanical structure that covered the armor. The blade vibrated at a high frequency at an indiscernible range with extremely strong cutting power. Beside the blade, there were two rows of cannon muzzles with holes. Every time the blade hit the target, these holes would spew out gunpowder and explode. It could also cause thermal explosions and electromagnetic overclocking to enter the second form of overpower, just like "Weapon Liberation."

Sparks and lightning, violent and cool.

Bang! Bang! Bang!

Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang! Ashes kept controlling the Diamond Shield to block. He frowned slightly. Melee was not his strong suit. He retracted the particles around his body and wanted to use the same move to destroy Han Xiao's mech. However, a few vibrating sonic spheres that followed Han Xiao's movements ruined his plan.

The sonic waves were released toward Han Xiao, forming a sonic shield on the surface of his body. When the carbon particles got close, they would be bounced away and could not stick to the surface of the mech at all.

The three of them fought fiercely. Ashes's expression was no longer as relaxed as before. Han Xiao made him feel that he was a little difficult to deal with. It seemed that he was not the only one who had improved. He originally thought that he could quickly finish off Black Star, but now he was actually being held back.

In Ashes's expectations, only Nagojin was more difficult to deal with. Now, he realized that Black Star was not easy to deal with either. However, Ashes felt that this was a good opportunity!

Discovering this in advance was much better than being caught off guard in a chaotic battle.

The enemy had split into two, and Black Star was taking the risk to hold him back. He did not have many helpers around him, so this was the best opportunity to get rid of a strong enemy.

With that thought, Ashes's expression changed.

He originally wanted to find Anur as soon as possible, but now, he did not mind spending more time to get rid of any future problems.

At this time, Han Xiao, who was in the midst of the fierce battle, let out a light laugh.

"Aha, your eyes are not bad. I can feel a stronger murderous aura. It seems like you want to waste more time with me."

"I don't think this is a waste of time." Ashes coldly said, "Most of your machinery is paralyzed, and I will be able to dismantle this mechanical suit of yours sooner or later. By then, what other tricks do you have?"

"What other tricks do I have?" Han Xiao laughed, and his tone suddenly changed. "Then feel it with your body!"

Hum!

Mechanical Force gushed out like a shockwave, sweeping through all the machinery.

The next moment, the paralyzed machinery was reactivated by [Waste Modification], and all weapons were on standby!

War Mechanics were born for war!

Boom! Boom!

Ember was caught off guard and was sent flying. His face was covered in dirt, but he quickly used his ability to block the follow-up attack. Although it was not a big deal,

Although he was not injured, he was indeed injured!

Ashes suddenly raised his head, and rage surged in his eyes.

The pain had awakened the memory of Han Xiao in his body.

The humiliation that was gradually fading away was suddenly revived at this moment!

—
